title: Autonomous Lunar Logistics System (ALLS)
description: An educational demonstration of AI-powered mission planning and fleet monitoring concepts for autonomous spacecraft operations. Features multi-agent coordination, digital twin visualization, and edge autonomy concepts for lunar logistics scenarios.
notes: SPECIFICATION PHASE: This repository contains the architectural specification and design documents for an educational demonstration of autonomous spacecraft mission planning. Implementation is in progress. This is NOT certified for actual spaceflight operations.
